title: Hearing on the City's Green Economy Action Plan
summary: The Council will examine progress on the Green Economy Action Plan, a 2024 initiative by the Economic Development Corporation and NYC Talent aiming for 400,000 green jobs by 2040. The hearing will focus on the South Brooklyn Marine Terminal and Empire Wind offshore wind project, the Brooklyn Army Terminal Climate Innovation Hub, and workforce training commitments, amid federal funding threats and uncertainty over whether the new administration will continue the plan.
